hypothesis: The current integrated detector reproduces its retained measured-support and positive evidence, providing a valid baseline for single-mechanism changes to extrapolated corridor certification.
criterion: Complete every fixed recording without missing or duplicate acquisitions. Preserve per-frame positive presence and intersection evidence, person localization and continuity; no increase in negative alarm episodes, alarm frames or unknown coverage within either fixed partition. Report unresolved evidence separately. A scalar improvement never overrides a failed gate.
limits: No independent blind holdout is available: use the frozen previously inspected evaluation partition without retuning it.
Thirty fresh-state diagnostic scans reproduce within-scan support, never continuous confirmations or track history.
Person oriented boxes are author-reviewed detector-assisted full-person volumes; point membership is correspondence evidence, not semantic point truth.
Synthetic events use frozen forensic original-return attribution, not field recall. Events 5 and 7 remain explicit contour disagreements.
Unknown and unresolved are not clear route. Negative organizer statements do not provide exhaustive point labels or precision.
Timing is instrumented offline detector processing on this machine, not live sensor-to-display latency.
